lines.text: Hey there, my name is Ayman Elsawah, and I've been in security for quite a long time.
And I'm here to help make everything I've learned accessible to you.

So I wrote a book.
Basically, it's just a guide.

Talk about all the different things and culture and whatnot just if you're starting from zero but then i noticed that there's so many ways that you could get into the field so no need to take my word for it so i started a podcast called Getting Into Infosec where i documented people's journeys into the field so that you can be motivated and learn to get into the field

There have been hairdressers car mechanics librarians even had a couple notable people come on as well so go ahead and check that out fast forward a little bit and being the entrepreneur that i am i started doing this stuff at like 16. i wanted to make cyber security accessible to like startups because startups couldn't afford a full-time security person for whatever reason we're not going to blame them you know it's totally fine but sometimes they don't need to have a full-time security person it could be a cost issue or just
